B"H

# Pass One — Chesed

Boruch Hashem. Blessed is He.

The Awtsmoos gives generously: every public Road should reveal title, canonical identity, description, H1, Torah text, Heichel context, and author context in the first response from Awtsmoos.com.

## Ideal behavior

- Numeric Road resolves ordered series index to stable post ID server-side.
- Named series-post route and numeric Road render the same title/body identity.
- Semantic metadata is generated from the same resolved data.
- Initial HTML contains a semantic article without JavaScript.
- JavaScript enhances the article with commentary, controls, navigation, and client state.
- Missing posts never look indexable.
- New calm/mobile reader CSS and controls remain intact.
